svg.title: Andes & Río de la Plata
svg.desc: Selected, sourced connections. Arrows label unions, divisions, conquest, independence, changes in rule, and contact. Node positions do not measure time or ancestry. Andean cultural interactions, Spanish conquest, colonial reorganisation and selected independence histories. Caral is shown without an unsupported succession arrow. Select a node for Wikipedia or an arrow for its sources.
svg.text: Tap a node to read · Tap an arrow for the event and sources
